digest.component_or_area: LLM Review gate / Bedrock provider integration
propositions: review-bot container has no AWS region configured, causing boto3.client('bedrock-runtime') to raise NoRegionError at client construction before any model call
REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION environment variable is unset in the container, so build_bedrock_provider passes region=None to BedrockProvider which falls back to boto3's failed ambient resolution
boto3 region discovery via botocore only recognizes AWS_DEFAULT_REGION (not AWS_REGION), so the ambient resolution chain fails in the container environment
pre-flight validation must check boto3.session.Session().region_name explicitly and raise typed LLMConfigError naming REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION rather than allowing bare boto3 NoRegionError to surface
IMDS reachability is orthogonal to region resolution in botocore, so fixing IMDS access does not supply a region and both concerns must be configured independently
CloudWatch voter metrics silently fail for the same missing-region root cause, affecting the rollback plan's dependency on VOTER_ERROR alarms
